metadata.name: Express Lobby
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A skyscraper's elevator core is the arena: six open glass cabs race up and down a 48 m neon atrium, and the shaft runs over anyone in a car's way. Hop cab to cab, ride up to the two mezzanines that hold the hills, take the roof with its gunship, and hit the machine-room console to drop cab C's floor out from under its riders (hold jump for a parachute: long falls kill).

do.text: Express Lobby. Cabs do not stop for you: mind the shaft.
Cab C floor released! Hold jump to open a parachute.
